policy: Verified positive and negative news feeds a bounded, time-decaying simulation overlay; base assumptions remain owner-controlled.

items.headline: V: W-5 reentry debuts vertically integrated satellite bus
items.summary: V’s newsroom highlights W-5 reentry (Jan 29, 2026) as the first reentry of its vertically integrated W-Series vehicle, featuring in-house satellite bus/capsule/heatshield technology.

items.headline: O: Form D filed for O Startup Fund II, L.P. (effectiveness)
items.summary: SEC Form D (notice of exempt offering of securities) shows effectiveness dated 2026-08-26 for O Startup Fund II, L.P., suggesting active private capital raising.

items.headline: O: cyber-capabilities pacing post mentions Astra threshold risk
items.summary: O published a post discussing rising risks from increasingly capable systems and notes preliminary evidence Astra may meet a “Critical cybersecurity capability” threshold under its Preparedness Framework.

items.headline: G: $350M Series A; valuation cited at $3.5B
items.summary: G announced closure of a $350M Series A led by Disruptive (planned NVIDIA participation), citing a $3.5B valuation and plans to accelerate its inference footprint, including MW scaling to 200+ in 2027.
